# l2-scripts

The scripts that L2's tools and skills run, with their tests and fixtures: the L1 recommendation scenario candidates (`l1-recommendation-scenarios.ts`) and the vocabulary reader they resolve against (`l1-scenario-vocabulary.ts`, with smart-base's generic personas under `fixtures/`), the L2 DTH validator (`dth/check-l2-dth.ts`), the L2 programme indicators drafter (`l2-program-indicators.py`), the DAK data-dictionary annex writer and term diff (`dak-data-dictionary.ts`, `dak-data-dictionary-diff.ts`), and the DAK components figure generator (`gen-dak-components-figure.ts`).

Part of [SMART Base](../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `l2-scripts`, holding `code`.
